parameters.name: AccountAttr
parameters.description: The properties of the new account. In the console, click Account Properties in the top menu bar to go to the **Security Settings** page and view the properties.

parameters.name: CityName
parameters.description: The name of the city in English.

parameters.name: EnterpriseName
parameters.description: The name of the enterprise. This is the enterprise name that corresponds to the Unified Social Credit Code.

parameters.name: FirstName
parameters.description: The first name of the user under the level 1 category.

parameters.name: LastName
parameters.description:
The last name of the user.

Maximum length: 64 characters.

parameters.name: LoginEmail
parameters.description: The logon email address of the member account.

parameters.name: ProvinceName
parameters.description: The name of the province. This parameter is optional.
